fixture: Fresh populated Homebrew/brew clones on macOS arm64/APFS. Git 2.56.0. Ordinary CLI spawn with omitted history. First status timed separately.

methods.forwardAndReverse: Six rotating fresh triples in each order: current release, one buffered Git process validating metadata sizes, exact commit/tree/attribute bytes and all blob types, linked worktree.
methods.phases: Six rotating triples in one executable: existing concurrent checks (release), one persistent verifier (candidate), persistent commit/attribute and blob checks alongside a native tree walk (walk).
methods.offsetForwardAndReverse: Six rotating triples in each order: current release, pack-offset ordering hints for the same native blob requests, linked worktree. All requests including duplicates and loose objects retained.
methods.offsetConfirm: Same executable with and without ordering hints, plus linked worktree. Candidate emits optional planning and type-check durations.
methods.critical: Six alternating groups of four fresh clones: ordinary, ordered, ordered, ordinary or the reverse. Each pair compares the mean of two samples per arm. Readiness, link checkout and file-worker completion recorded relative to launching file workers. Each per-run files_done summary uses the last worker.
methods.gitOnly: Each query gets its own freshly installed store after no-checkout local spawn. Native Git response compared byte-for-byte with expected output. Pack offsets for the ordering microbenchmark were computed outside its query timer.

decision: Retain the existing verifier and request ordering. In the bracketed comparison Git finished checking blob types about 30 ms sooner in pack-offset order, and link checkout finished 27 ms sooner. The last regular-file worker still finished at 158 ms in both arms. Four of six full-spawn groups took longer.
